messages:
matt: Heads up — started rolling the 550->555 driver bundle to us-west2 and eu-central about 20m ago, and we’re seeing a provisioning regression: ~12% of GPU nodes never finish DKMS compile and end up NotReady. Logs show kernel header mismatches.
jen: Ugh. Any consistent pattern on image/kernel versions? region/node pool?
matt: Looks like the new image builder bumped some nodes to 5.19 kernels while the AMI we tested uses 5.15. DKMS on the node tries to build against /lib/modules/5.19 but the header package on the image is 5.15. Example from a failing node:```
uname -r
5.19.0-101-generic
ls /lib/modules
5.15.0-87-generic
dkms status
nvidia, 555.12: added
ERROR: cannot locate kernel source for 5.19.0-101-generic
```
aria: That mismatch explains the "version magic" modprobe failures I saw earlier (`nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout`).
infra-oncall: Current impact: autoscaler keeps replacing failed nodes with new ones from the same image set, so failures are self-perpetuating in the affected pools. us-west2-gpu-pool-3 and eu-central-batch are most hit.
sam: Are any nodes successfully provisioning with 555? If yes we can roll those pools forward and isolate the bad AMI.
matt: Yes, some pools with pinned image id finish fine. The bad ones are using the new rolling image tag. Suspect image builder job omitted linux-headers or pointed at wrong meta package.
jen: Can we stop the rollout and pin affected node pools back to the previous image? That buys us time while infra opens a builder rollback.
aria: +1. Also we should add a small gate in our provisioning: check that `uname -r` has matching headers in /lib/modules before running dkms. Quick fix script:```
if [ -d /lib/modules/"$(uname -r)" ]; then
  echo ok
else
  echo missing-headers
  exit 1
fi
```
deploy-bot: [deploy] Rolling driver rollout paused for us-west2-gpu-pool-3 by matt at 1990123500 :pause_button:
infra-oncall: I'm creating an emergency AMI rollback PR and tagging builders to stop current image promotion. Also bumping autoscaler to not auto-replace failures for 10m to avoid churn.
matt: Thanks. Can infra also add a quick probe in the fleet daemon to report header/kernel mismatch counts to the console dashboard? We need visibility for other regions.
sam: I'll add a short-term alert: if >5% of recent GPU node provisions fail DKMS within 15m, fire pager to infra-oncall.
jen: After rollback we should re-run dkms build tests against a matrix of kernels we see in the wild (5.15, 5.19) and gate image promotions. Also add a post-image unit that verifies linux-headers package matches uname.
aria: FYI, some nodes that failed but were manually reprovisioned against the pinned AMI came back healthy; suggests driver itself is fine — it's the headers/image mismatch.
matt: OK — plan: pause rollout (done), block image promotion (infra), add probe & alert (sam), fix image builder to install correct headers and run dkms smoke (infra + jen). Reopen rollout after green window. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
